title: Predict the values i takes
idea: Given any range(start, stop, step), list the values the loop variable takes. Tracing the sequence is the Check skill for stepping loops.

exercises.explanation: Start 0, step 3: 0, 3, 6, 9. Next is 12, past the stop of 10, so it stops at 9.
2, 4, 6, 8, 10 — five values. Next is 12, excluded. Five passes.

exercises.prompt: range(3, 3) produces no values (it is empty).
exercises.explanation: Start equals stop, so there's nothing to count — zero passes. An empty range is valid and safe.
i takes 1, then 2, then 3, printing each in turn.
Start 5, step 5: 5, 10, 15. Next is 20, which equals the stop and is excluded.

exercises.prompt: What is the LAST value i takes in range(1, 10, 2)?
exercises.explanation: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 — the last is 9. The next, 11, is past the stop of 10.

exercises.prompt: Match each range to its value list.
exercises.explanation: Start included, stop excluded, step controls the spacing and direction. Trace each one carefully.

exercises.prompt: Best way to be sure a tricky range does what you want?
options: Write out the values by hand before trusting the loop
exercises.explanation: Listing the values by hand catches off-by-one and wrong-step mistakes. Trace first, trust second.
